items.question: Will parking be available?
items.answer: Yes, guest parking will be marked at the venue entrance. Please arrive a few minutes early.

items.question: Are children invited?
items.answer: We love your children, but the reception is mainly adults only unless noted on your invitation.

items.question: What is the weather like in October?
items.answer: Days are usually mild and evenings can be cooler. A light jacket is recommended.

items.question: Can I bring a plus one?
items.answer: Please refer to the guest count shown on your invitation or in the RSVP form.
